question: Where can I get a list of stand-alone battery storage (BESS) projects currently in permitting in Australia, with location, power (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: There is no single national list. Best official sources: the NSW Major Projects register (102 stand-alone BESS cases across stages with stage, LGA, address, map point, MW in text, decision date once determined) and the national EPBC referrals ArcGIS layer (104 battery-named federal referrals across stages with polygon, state and federal stage). Other states differ: WA's DAP list and VIC permit pages give stage, dates and applicant; QLD and SA lists are script-rendered and refuse automated clients. Developer and open-stage dates are mostly inside PDFs. AEMO's NEM xlsx helps discovery but its commitment status is not a permit stage.
main_caveats: Federal EPBC referral status is a separate environmental process: a 'Completed' referral says nothing about state development consent, and many BESS are never referred.
MW basis differs between sources: grid export, installed rating and AEMO AC nameplate (Wattle Creek: 350 MW export, up to 516 MW rating, 372.6 MW AC).
Hybrids: QLD assesses BESS ancillary to wind/solar inside that application; NSW splits hubs into separate cases; WA's list mixes both. Filter by description.
VIC, QLD, SA and TAS planning sites and the NT EPA register answered 403 to automated clients on 2026-11-26; VIC was read only through archived copies.
AEMO commitment status is not a permit stage: Tramway Road (VIC permit 31/10/2025) is still 'Publicly Announced' in the October 2026 release.
answer.confidence_reason: NSW, EPBC, WA, ACT and AEMO were tested by query or document; QLD and SA rows could not be read (403/script), so coverage outside NSW is partial.

how_to_use.example_result: 13 results; e.g. 'SSD-63345458 | Assessment | State Significant Development | Upper Lachlan Shire | Wattle Creek Battery Energy Storage System | 1001 Canyonleigh Road Brayton Nsw 2579'
steps: Query /major-projects/projects with development_type=Electricity generation - Other and again with development_type=Electricity Supply; page with &page=0..N (9 rows per page).

Keep rows whose name contains 'Battery', 'BESS' or 'Energy Storage'; set aside pumped hydro, '-Mod-' rows and 'Withdrawn'. On 2026-11-26 this gave 102 BESS cases (Prepare EIS 30, Determination 25, Response to Submissions 14, Assessment 11, Withdrawn 8, Exhibition 6, SEARs 4, no stage shown 4).
Open each project page for description (MW/MWh), EPBC ID, sub-stage, map point and, if decided, Decision and Determination Date.

For applicant and dates of open stages, open the documents: folder lists come from /major-projects-attachments-data/{nid}/folder_{n}/attachment (JSON) and link to getContent?AttachRef=<case>!<upload timestamp> PDFs.
reading_traps: BESS are split across two development types; filtering only 'Electricity generation - Other' misses about 34 cases filed under 'Electricity Supply'.
List stage and page 'Current Status' can differ (Wattle Creek: list 'Assessment', page 'Prepare Amendment Report').
'Determination' means decided: read Decision (approved/refused) on the page; consent surrendered cases keep the label (e.g. 'Hume Battery Energy Storage System (Consent Surrendered)').
Applicant is not a page field; it is in documents (letters, notice of decision).
MW mixes export and installed rating; amendments change MW (350 MW export vs up to 516 MW rating).
Hybrid hubs are split into separate cases (Wattle Creek BESS vs Wattle Creek Solar).

problems: No bulk export or documented API for this register found; the list is paged HTML.
Applicant and open-stage dates are not structured fields.

MW: take the figure from the consent or latest amendment and record its basis (export vs rating); do not copy AEMO MW as the permitted MW.

where_published.name: NSW Major Projects case documents
where_published.what: SEARs, EIS, amendment letters, notices of decision and consents per SSD case.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Open the project page; each folder loads from /major-projects-attachments-data/{nid}/folder_{n}/attachment (JSON) with getContent PDF links; upload timestamp is inside AttachRef.

example_document.what_it_gives: Page 1: 'SPARK RENEWABLES PTY LIMITED'; 'Amendment Report which was submitted on 1 July 2026'; 'up to 516 MW with a storage capacity of up to 1,580 MWh, however retaining the 350 MW grid export capacity'; dated 3/07/2026.

where_published.name: WA Development Assessment Panel agendas (Responsible Authority Reports)
where_published.what: Per meeting agenda PDF with a Form 1 Responsible Authority Report per application.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Agenda list per panel (Regional, Metro Inner, Metro Outer) with keyword and year search; titles give date, number and shire; match the DAP reference from the current applications PDF.

example_document.what_it_gives: RAR page 1: 'DAP File No: DAP/26/03199'; 'Owner: Tronox Management Pty Ltd'; 'Applicant: SLR Consulting'; 'Application Acceptance Date: 4 September 2026'; proposal: 'A 38MW BESS facility'.

where_published.name: Victoria ministerial permits register (permit pages)
where_published.what: One page per Minister-decided permit application with dates, decision, applicant, land and supporting documents.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Register search runs by script; live site refuses automated clients. Archived permit pages (web.archive.org) are readable when captured.

example_document.what_it_gives: 'Application received Date: 17/12/2024'; 'Date of Notice: 19/06/2025'; 'Decision: Permit Date of decision: 31/10/2025'; 'Applicant name: Eku Energy Pty Ltd'; 'Address of Land: 675 Monash Way Hazelwood North VIC 3840'.

where_published.name: ACT Legislation Register notifiable instruments
where_published.what: Notices of approval of impact-track development applications with the notice of decision attached.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Notifiable instruments titled 'Planning and Development (Approval of Application – DA… – …) Notice'.

example_document.what_it_gives: 'battery energy storage system of up to 300 megawatts and associated works at Blocks 1634 and 1635 in Belconnen'; 'On 14 April 2025 ... approved the DA in the impact track'; 'Application lodged: 18 October 2024'.

related_not_answering.name: AEMO Key Connection Information (KCI) datafile
related_not_answering.why: Lists grid connection enquiries/applications to network operators (9,719 rows), not planning permits.

related_not_answering.name: Clean Energy Council industry snapshot (former project tracker)
related_not_answering.why: Redirects to aggregate figures for financial close and commissioning; no project list.

related_not_answering.name: NT EPA environmental impact assessments register
related_not_answering.why: State environmental assessment, not development consent; live site 403 and latest archive is 2022.

open_questions: In the EPBC layer REFERRAL_DECISION is empty in 97 of 104 battery-named referrals although status says 'Referral Decision Made'; only the agency can confirm the decision type (notices load by script).
Referrals received from 1 December 2026 fall under new EPBC laws; whether the public portal and spatial layer keep the same fields and labels is not yet known.

history.note: First pass: NSW register and EPBC layer tested by query, WA/VIC/ACT consent documents read; QLD and SA registers unreadable to automated clients.

local_terms.meaning: NSW state assessment pathway used by large BESS; case numbers SSD-… in the Major Projects register.

Victorian land-use term in BESS permit descriptions ('utility installation comprising a Battery Energy Storage System').
Victorian pathway where the Minister decides; shown as 'Program' on ministerial permit pages.
WA panels deciding large BESS applications; references DAP/YY/NNNNN.
Federal environmental referral and the decision that full assessment is needed.
AEMO development stage (Publicly Announced, Anticipated, Committed); not a planning stage.
